definition.zh-TW: 把公司在報表日控制的資源（資產）和這些資源的資金來源分列兩側；內容都以報表日為準，所以標題只寫一個日期。資金來源有兩種：對債權人負有清償義務的是負債；不必償還、由股東承擔經營成敗的是股東權益。資產的每一塊錢都有來源，兩側合計因此一定相等。IFRS 稱它為財務狀況表。
definition.en: Sets out the resources the company controls at the reporting date (assets) alongside the sources of the money behind them; everything in it is stated as at that one date, so the heading carries a single date. The sources come in two kinds: liabilities, which the company is obliged to settle with its creditors, and equity, which need not be repaid and takes the shareholders’ share of the business’s successes and failures. Every dollar of assets has a source, so the two sides always total the same. IFRS calls it the statement of financial position.
